title: Orphaned workload
brief: The service is failing after a workload rename. Find the extra resource and the selector mismatch.

checks.question: Which Deployment is left behind after the rename?
checks.hint: Look for the Deployment marked as requiring pruning.
checks.why: The tree shows desired and leftover resources together.

truth.cause: The new Deployment name and Service selector leave an orphan and no endpoints
truth.fix: Restore the selector and prune only the orphan
